==Background==
"'''Ready Steady'''" is a original song by Giga. It was commissioned as the first unit song for {{IW|ProjectSekai|Vivid BAD SQUAD}} from the game ''{{IW|projectsekai|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE!|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE! feat. Hatsune Miku}}''.

The VOCALOID version has entered the ''[[Hall of Legend]]'' and exceeded over 10 million YouTube views. Hence, this is one of Giga’s most notable songs.

==Other media appearances==
===Discography===
This song is featured on the following albums:
* ''Ready Steady (single)''
* ''[[バーチャル・シンガーボーカルアルバム (Virtual Singer Vocal Album)|Virtual Singer Vocal Album]]''

===Video games===
This song is featured in the following video games:
*''{{IW|projectsekai|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE!|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE! feat. Hatsune Miku}}'' (Virtual Singer version by Kagamine Rin, Hatsune Miku, and Kagamine Len; SEKAI version by Vivid BAD SQUAD and Hatsune Miku)
*''O.N.G.E.K.I.'' (SEKAI version by Vivid BAD SQUAD and Hatsune Miku)
*''CHUNITHM SUN'' (SEKAI version by Vivid BAD SQUAD and Hatsune Miku)
